Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series Orlando, Florida 2026

Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series Orlando, Florida 2026 Event Details

We are pleased to announce the next Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series event will take place in Orlando, Florida on November 6-8, 2026!

A Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series (YCS) is a big, exciting 3-day event that takes place from Friday to Sunday. Duelists from all over will attend to compete for exclusive prizes, earn invites to their next World Championship Qualifier, and spend the weekend Dueling, trading, and hanging out with hundreds of other Yu-Gi-Oh! fans.

YCS feature two main events. Friday is Day 1 for Genesys, Saturday is Day 1 for Advanced, and both formats conclude with Day 2 on Sunday.

In addition to the two main events, there are numerous Public Events for both Genesys and Advanced, such as Win-A-Mat & More Attack of the Giant Card!!, and Regional Qualifier tournaments. There is also Dragon Duel tournaments for Duelists born in the year 2013 or later. Competitive or casual, there is something for everyone to do at a Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series weekend event.
